university.name: University of Glasgow
university.summary: A Scottish research university founded in 1451, based at the Gilmorehill campus in Glasgow. It teaches undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across four colleges and offers a Pakistan country page and several scholarships open to Pakistani applicants.

courses.title: Data Analytics
courses.overview: A one-year on-campus Masters covering statistical modelling and computational methods for learning from data, with applied analytics projects. Prior study of statistics or computing science is not required, but a substantial mathematics component is.
courses.academic_requirements: 2.1 Hons (or non-UK equivalent) in a degree with a substantial Mathematics component: at least 20% of credit-bearing modules in university-level mathematics, at an average grade of pass.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no subtest less than 6.0. PTE Academic 65 overall (Reading 60, Listening 60, Speaking 65, Writing 60). TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 92 overall, no subtest less than 4.5. Duolingo English Test 120 overall, writing 120, no subtest less than 110.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a Bachelor's degree (4 years) is required for postgraduate taught entry. UK 2.1 equivalent is stated as 58% to 68% or GPA 2.9 to 3.25, depending on the awarding institution.
courses.career_notes: The page names medical research, the pharmaceutical industry, finance and government statistical services as destinations, and notes some graduates progress to PhD study.
courses.application_deadline_note: International and EU applicants apply in six rounds for September 2027 entry, from 1 October 2026 (Round 1 closes 5 November 2026) to Round 6 closing 8 July 2027. UK applicants: 24 August 2027.
courses.notes: Not open to recent University of Glasgow Statistics graduates because of content overlap. A separate part-time online MSc exists and is not covered here.

courses.title: International Accounting and Financial Management
courses.overview: A one-year Masters in the Adam Smith Business School combining international accounting, corporate finance and data analytics. It suits applicants who already have accounting or finance modules and want careers in accounting, audit, consulting or tax.
highlights: International Financial Accounting for Multi-National Companies
courses.academic_requirements: 2.1 Hons (or non-UK equivalent) in any subject, with at least five credit-bearing modules in accounting and/or finance at an average grade of pass.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no subtest below 6.0 (General Training not accepted). PTE Academic 65 overall (Reading, Listening and Writing 60, Speaking 65; online PTE Academic not accepted). TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 92 overall, no subtest below 4.5. Duolingo English Test 120 overall, writing 120, no subtest less than 110.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a Bachelor's degree (4 years) is required for postgraduate taught entry. UK 2.1 equivalent is stated as 58% to 68% or GPA 2.9 to 3.25, depending on the awarding institution.
courses.career_notes: The page lists accountancy, management advice, audit and assurance, consultancy and tax, and names KPMG, Deloitte, PwC and EY among recent employers of graduates.

courses.title: International Law
courses.duration_text: 12 months full-time (24 months part-time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year Masters covering the breadth of contemporary international law, including trade disputes, human rights litigation, state responsibility and international criminal law. Extra-curricular activities include moot court competitions and field trips to The Hague and Geneva.
highlights: Advanced Introduction to International Criminal Law
courses.academic_requirements: 2.1 Hons (or non-UK equivalent) in Law, International Relations or Politics. Degrees in other relevant subjects at 2.1 may be considered with a personal statement and academic reference.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, Writing 6.5, no subtest below 6.0. PTE Academic (test centre) 70 overall, Writing 68, Listening 60, Reading 60, Speaking 65. TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 98 overall, Writing 5, no other subtest below 4.5. Duolingo English Test 130 overall, writing 130, no subtest below 110.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a Bachelor's degree (4 years) is required for postgraduate taught entry. UK 2.1 equivalent is stated as 58% to 68% or GPA 2.9 to 3.25, depending on the awarding institution.
courses.career_notes: The page mentions professional skills activities, career talks and internship eligibility but does not name specific employers or roles.
courses.notes: IELTS Writing minimum is 6.5 and the overall minimum is 7.0; min_ielts_band records the general subtest floor of 6.0.

courses.title: Master of Business Administration
courses.overview: A one-year full-time MBA from the Adam Smith Business School. Core training in finance, operations, marketing and strategy is followed by a specialism in finance, marketing or strategy, with industry projects and a dissertation.
courses.academic_requirements: An honours degree (or non-UK equivalent) in any subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no subtest below 6.0 (General Training not accepted). PTE Academic (test centre) 65 overall, Reading, Listening and Writing 60, Speaking 65. TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 92 overall, no subtest below 4.5. Duolingo English Test 120 overall, writing 120, no subtest less than 110.
courses.experience_requirements: At least three years of professional work experience, showing responsibility for planning business aims and prioritising workload.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page lists postgraduate taught entry as a Bachelor's degree (4 years); the MBA page asks only for an honours degree or non-UK equivalent, with no stated class.
courses.career_notes: The page refers to Professional Development weeks and employability events, and names Amazon, Barclays, Deloitte and Diageo among employers of recent alumni.
courses.notes: The page states no minimum degree class, so uk_min_degree_class is null. The Glasgow MBA Scholarship page found was for September 2026 entry, so it is excluded.

courses.title: Civil Engineering
courses.overview: A one-year Masters building advanced civil engineering knowledge and problem-solving skills for graduates in civil engineering or a closely related field. It includes design projects and an individual MSc project.
courses.academic_requirements: 2.1 Hons (or non-UK equivalent) in an engineering discipline, or in physical sciences or mathematics with relevant modules. Some 2.2 applicants may be accepted with an average grade of 2.1 in accepted modules.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no subtest less than 6.0. PTE Academic 65 overall (Reading 60, Listening 60, Speaking 65, Writing 60). TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 92 overall, no subtest less than 4.5. Duolingo English Test 120 overall, writing 120, no subtest less than 110.
courses.experience_requirements: Extensive work experience may be considered alongside academic qualifications for applicants just below the academic requirements.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a Bachelor's degree (4 years) is required for postgraduate taught entry. UK 2.1 equivalent is stated as 58% to 68% or GPA 2.9 to 3.25, depending on the awarding institution.
courses.career_notes: The page lists civil, structural and environmental engineering roles with design consultants, contractors, public bodies and utilities, and names VINCI, Mott MacDonald and Atkins among employers of past graduates.
courses.notes: The page states a GBP 2,000 deposit is required.

courses.title: Economics
courses.overview: A one-year Masters applying economic theory to public policy, global development and sustainability, with workshops in software such as Python, R, Matlab, Stata and EViews. Core teaching covers econometrics, macroeconomics, mathematical methods and microeconomic theory.
courses.academic_requirements: 2.1 Honours (or non-UK equivalent) in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computing Science or a related quantitative discipline.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no subtest below 6.0 (General Training not accepted). PTE Academic (test centre) 65 overall, Reading 60, Listening 60, Speaking 65, Writing 60. TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026) 92 overall, no subtest below 4.5. Duolingo English Test 120 overall, writing 120, no subtest less than 110.
courses.experience_requirements: Applicants with a 2.1 Honours (or non-UK equivalent) in any subject and 2 years of professional work experience in a business, public sector, policy or financial services role are considered individually.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: a Bachelor's degree (4 years) is required for postgraduate taught entry. UK 2.1 equivalent is stated as 58% to 68% or GPA 2.9 to 3.25, depending on the awarding institution.
courses.career_notes: The page lists roles such as Economic Analyst, Policy Advisor, Consultant, Researcher and Data Scientist, in public policy, financial markets, forecasting and development planning.
courses.notes: Field classed as humanities-social-sciences because no economics-specific field slug exists.

scholarships.name: World Changers Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 per year (Medical, Veterinary and Life Sciences; Science and Engineering) or GBP 7,000 per year (Arts; Social Sciences) tuition fee discount, renewable subject to satisfactory progress
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee discount for new international and EU undergraduates with an offer for 2027 entry who meet the stated A Level or IB grade threshold for their programme. Assessed automatically on academic merit.
scholarships.criteria_text: New undergraduate with International or EU fee status, holding an offer for 2027 entry and meeting the A Level or IB (or local equivalent) threshold, for example AAB or IB 36 for most Social Sciences programmes. Pakistan is on the eligible country list.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; applicants under consideration are notified within two weeks of receiving an offer.
scholarships.notes: Full eligible country list not reviewed beyond confirming Pakistan; UK residents may or may not be included. Equivalences for Pakistani qualifications are not published (contact the university). Cannot be combined with other university scholarships except the Alumni Discount.

scholarships.name: World Changers Glasgow Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee discount for nationals of listed countries, including Pakistan, starting an eligible postgraduate taught programme in September 2027 or January 2028 with international fee status. No separate application is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: National of an eligible country (Pakistan included), international fee status, enrolled on an eligible postgraduate taught programme for September 2027 or January 2028. Cannot be combined with another university scholarship; withdrawn if fully externally sponsored.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated. Confirmation is sent soon after the programme offer is received.
scholarships.notes: Only programmes on the page's eligible list qualify; the list was not checked course by course.

scholarships.name: Global Leadership Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 tuition fee discount, applied for one year only (350 awards)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee discount for high-achieving international and EU applicants holding an offer on an eligible full-time, one-year, in-person taught Masters starting September 2027. Awarded on a rolling basis.
scholarships.criteria_text: Grades equivalent to a UK first-class honours degree, an offer on an eligible full-time one-year Masters starting September 2027, International or EU fee status, and a passport from an eligible country (Pakistan included).
scholarships.deadline_note: Application not yet open at time of checking; closing date not confirmed, the page says it is usually in late August.
scholarships.notes: Opening and closing dates unconfirmed. Cannot be combined with other university discounts or scholarships except the Alumni Discount.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships 2027
scholarships.provider_name: University of Glasgow with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 tuition fee waiver for one-year postgraduate study (3 awards)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee waiver for applicants from listed countries, including Pakistan, on a one-year taught postgraduate course other than the MBA or MSc Research. Applicants must have accepted a place and met all offer conditions by the deadline.
scholarships.criteria_text: Passport from an eligible country with international/EU fee status, accepted place with offer conditions met by the deadline, no other external or university funding, relevant work experience or proven subject interest, and commitment to GREAT scholar activities.
scholarships.deadline_note: Closing time 11:45 UK time on 30 April 2027; decisions announced 14 May 2027. The page says the application will open shortly.
scholarships.notes: The page does not state the intake year directly; 2027 entry is inferred from the award name and dates. The introduction names Pakistan, Bangladesh and Vietnam while the list also shows Greece and Spain. Page stated 'GREAT Scholarships 2027'.

scholarships.name: Alumni Discount
scholarships.value_text: 15% tuition fee discount for eligible self-funded alumni
scholarships.summary: A 15% tuition fee discount for self-funded University of Glasgow graduates and exchange or study abroad participants starting a full postgraduate taught Masters or research programme in 2027/28, from a listed country that includes Pakistan.
scholarships.criteria_text: Glasgow graduate or participant in a Study Abroad, International Summer School or Erasmus exchange programme; self-funded; enrolled on an eligible full PGT Masters or PGR programme; from a listed country (Pakistan and the UK nations included). Online, diploma and certificate programmes are excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: PGT discount is applied at registration; appeals are assessed until 31 January 2028. PGR applicants contact their Graduate School.
scholarships.notes: The page does not say whether an offer is required. The value_basis per_year is not stated by the page; the 15% is applied to tuition fees. Cannot be combined with partnership discounts or with scholarships covering 100% of fees.
